principle: Free time is real temporal capacity left after obligations. NPCs may form autonomous leisure intentions from persistent preferences and available capabilities; the player's leisure is never auto-selected.
rules: A free-time activity must fit wholly inside an existing uncommitted schedule interval including required travel.
Free-time planning cannot move, delete or overlap required Academy commitments.
NPC selection may use persistent hobbies, interests and explicit preferences; species is not a leisure selector.
Player proximity, camera presence, dialogue initiation or narrative convenience cannot bias NPC activity selection.
The player character receives feasible options and no automatic activity choice.
An explicit player choice is accepted only if the activity, facility, capacity, leave state and travel are valid.
Activity locations/capabilities must pre-exist; the planner cannot invent a gym, holodeck, room, reservation or city access.
Finite capacity is respected when supplied by activity/facility state.
Authorized leave is required for activities marked off-campus/leave-gated.
An interval may remain partly or wholly unallocated; free time does not need to be filled.
A free-time plan is an intention/tentative schedule state and is not proof of actual execution or physical presence.
Public/common-space leisure creates co-location opportunity only; Step 6 does not create participants, encounters or relationship changes.
No automatic friendship, rivalry, romance, attraction, wellbeing effect, disciplinary consequence or habit formation occurs in Step 6.
Repeated actual activities may later feed shared wellbeing/habit systems, but Step 6 only plans free time.
Extracurriculars, seminars/additional courses, social events, romance and NPC relationship evolution remain later Academy Life steps.
